result.instructions: Tools for Azure DevOps, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which pull requests are waiting for review in our main repository?"; "Show me the last 10 failed builds of the release pipeline."; "List the active bugs assigned to the mobile team in the Fabrikam project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Azure DevOps data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run azuredevops_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run azuredevops_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run azuredevops_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. azuredevops_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: azuredevops_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects in the Azure DevOps organization. Good first call to discover project names. Azure DevOps API: GET /_apis/projects.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: azuredevops_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project's details (name, description, state, visibility). Azure DevOps API: GET /_apis/projects/{projectId}.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

tools.name: azuredevops_list_repositories
tools.title: List repositories
tools.description: List the Git repositories in a project, with their default branch and web URL. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/git/repositories.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

tools.name: azuredevops_list_pull_requests
tools.title: List pull requests
tools.description: List pull requests in one repository, by default the active ones. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/git/repositories/{repositoryId}/pullrequests.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

target_branch.description: Only pull requests into this branch, for example "main".

top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: azuredevops_get_pull_request
tools.title: Get a pull request
tools.description: Get one pull request: title, description, status, reviewers, source and target branches. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/git/pullrequests/{pullRequestId}.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

pull_request_id.description: Pull request id (the number in its URL).

tools.name: azuredevops_list_build_definitions
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List build pipeline definitions in a project, optionally filtered by name. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/build/definitions.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: azuredevops_list_builds
tools.title: List builds
tools.description: List recent pipeline runs (builds) in a project, filtered by pipeline, status, result or branch. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/build/builds.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: azuredevops_get_build
tools.title: Get a build
tools.description: Get one pipeline run: status, result, requester, source branch, start and finish times. Azure DevOps API: GET /{project}/_apis/build/builds/{buildId}.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

build_id.description: Build id (the number in the build URL).

tools.name: azuredevops_query_work_items
tools.title: Query work items
tools.description: Run a WIQL query and return the matching work item ids. Use azuredevops_get_work_items for the fields. Azure DevOps API: POST /{project}/_apis/wit/wiql.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

wiql.description: WIQL text, for example SELECT [System.Id] FROM WorkItems WHERE [System.State] = 'Active'.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: azuredevops_get_work_items
tools.title: Get work items
tools.description: Get work items by id, with the requested fields (default: the standard fields). Azure DevOps API: POST /{project}/_apis/wit/workitemsbatch.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

ids.description: Work item ids, up to 200 per call.

fields.description: Field reference names, for example System.Title, System.State, System.AssignedTo.

tools.name: azuredevops_create_work_item
tools.title: Create a work item
tools.description: Create one work item (for example a Task or a Bug) in a project. Writes to the tracker; it is not idempotent. Azure DevOps API: POST /{project}/_apis/wit/workitems/${type}.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

work_item_type.description: Work item type, for example Task, Bug or User Story.

description.description: Description, as HTML or plain text (System.Description).

tools.name: azuredevops_create_pull_request_comment
tools.title: Comment on a pull request
tools.description: Post a new comment thread on a pull request. Writes to the repository review; it is not idempotent. Azure DevOps API: POST /{project}/_apis/git/repositories/{repositoryId}/pullRequests/{pullRequestId}/threads.

project.description: Project name or id, for example "Fabrikam".

pull_request_id.description: Pull request id (the number in its URL).
